preset.name: GTM & sales
preset.tagline: Outbound, signals, GTM engineering, and sales tools
preset.description: What's working in B2B go-to-market: signal-based selling, outbound, GTM engineering, AI SDRs, and what Clay, Gong, Monaco and the rest are shipping.

focus.audience: a GTM, sales, or revenue team at a B2B software company
care_about: Signal-based selling and outbound playbooks with real results: sequences, reply rates, meetings booked
GTM engineering: Clay workflows, enrichment, data waterfalls, and automating the sales process
AI SDRs and AI sales agents: what actually works, what doesn't, and real numbers
Sales tools: launches, features, and pricing from Clay, Monaco, Gong, Attio, Apollo, Unify, Common Room, and others
Founder-led sales, pipeline building, win rates, and sales leadership takes backed by data
Pricing and packaging moves in B2B and AI software
skip: Generic motivational sales content and engagement-bait lead magnets ('comment PLAYBOOK and I'll DM you')
Politics, regulation, macro, and stock moves
Big-lab model launches unless they change how sales teams work
